page_title: TOU 0-0 REN | Toulouse v Rennes 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than low towards the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
90+2' Guela Doue (Rennes) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+2' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Rennes have a corner.
90+1' Jeremy Stinat shows the yellow card to Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) for a heavy challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
86' Arthur Theate (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
83' This shall not pass! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
82' Substitution. Gabriel Suazo did his best and is replaced by Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse).
78' Here is a change. Ludovic Blas is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Guela Doue (Rennes).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) is replacing Martin Terrier.
77' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

77' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Steve Mandanda to dive and make a save. The ball goes out for a corner. Toulouse can continue in their attacking effort.
75' Frank Magri (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

74' Excellent touch by Martin Terrier (Rennes)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
71' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Naatan Skytta (Toulouse) replacing Cesar Gelabert Pina.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Cristian Casseres walks off the pitch to be replaced by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse).
71' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) but poses no threat.
67' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
63' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
62' Frank Magri (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Toulouse earn a corner.
58' Julien Stephan decides to make a substitution. Adrien Truffert will be replaced by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Le Fee leaves the pitch and Nemanja Matic (Rennes) comes on.
57' Ibrahim Cissoko goes off the pitch and Frank Magri (Toulouse) comes on.
57' Mikkel Desler doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
55' The game is interrupted now, Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
52' It's like he was asking for a caution. Logan Costa (Toulouse) receives a yellow card.
52' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

51' Martin Terrier (Rennes) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
51' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
50' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
48' Neat link-up play between Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) and Thijs Dallinga, but Steve Mandanda reads the game well and the move breaks down.
48' That's a well played offside trap. Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) is flagged for offside, ending the attack.
46' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The foul by Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jeremy Stinat.
45' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul. Rennes are awarded a free kick.
41' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Toulouse have a free kick.
34' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guillaume Restes intercepts the ball.
33' 8:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
28' Problems for Julien Stephan as Lorenz Assignon is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Desire Doue (Rennes) replaces him.
27' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
22' Toulouse take a short corner kick.
18' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Rennes.
15' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Today's referee Jeremy Stinat rightly decides to book Warmed Omari (Rennes) for his harsh tackle.
10' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
7' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
6' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) sees a yellow card from Jeremy Stinat after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
4' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
4' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
